setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "app-config-editor-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for app-config-editor skill evals"

evals.name: add-literal-setting-redacted
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: add a numeric package setting called EvalExportRowLimit with value 2500 to this package's app config, so flows can read it instead of hardcoding the limit. Show me the settings list afterwards so I can confirm it landed, and tell me how a function reads it.
evals.expected_output: The own appConfig row resolved from the list by applicationId == branch id and isExternal false, the body extracted in the same command as the fetch, one settingType 2 / valueType 4 entry appended, validate then upsert, and a verification that projects setting names/types only — with no connection binding value, key-like literal, or envelope ever echoed.
expectations: The own appConfig id is resolved from 'dxs configuration list appconfig' output by filtering applicationId equal to the branch id and isExternal false (or the resolved id is cross-checked against that filter) — not hardcoded
The fetch extracts the inner body (.configuration.json or .json) in the same command; the full envelope is never printed to the transcript
The new entry is {name: EvalExportRowLimit, description non-empty, settingType: 2, valueType: 4, value: 2500} with value as a JSON number
The new setting's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters
No apiConnectionName value of any settingType 1 entry appears in the transcript or the final answer (only names or <redacted>)
No literal value of a key/secret-like setting (a name containing Key, Secret, Password, or Scope/ClientId credentials) appears in the transcript
references[] and the body tail (configurationTypeId 32, id, referenceName appConfig, title, description, accessModifier) are unchanged in the pushed body
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate appconfig' run before 'dxs configuration upsert appconfig' (or before the documented update fallback)
The answer states the consumer reads it as $settings.<Package>.EvalExportRowLimit

evals.name: storage-connection-gate
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: I just added a storage component and 'dxs source branch validate' says 'There must be exactly one storage connection string configured'. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis that the package's appConfig lacks exactly one MongoDB binding; a settingType 1 / apiConnectionType 8 entry naming an existing organization MongoDb connection (looked up with a projection that never prints connectionString), validate then upsert on the own row, then branch validate re-run — or, if an existing binding is already present, a count-based diagnosis instead of a duplicate add.
expectations: The answer attributes the error to the appConfig settings (exactly one MongoDB connection binding required), not to the storage component body
The existing settings are inspected by projecting name/settingType/apiConnectionType only — never the full body or envelope
Any organization connection lookup projects name and apiConnectionTypeId only; connectionString is never printed
The added entry uses settingType 1 and apiConnectionType 8 with apiConnectionName equal to an existing organization connection name of type 8
After the edit the body has exactly one settingType 1 entry with apiConnectionType 8
No new appConfig is created; the write targets the own row resolved by applicationId == branch id and isExternal false
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate appconfig' run before 'dxs configuration upsert appconfig' (or the documented update fallback)
'dxs source branch validate' is re-run after the write

evals.name: never-create-and-route-references
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a new appConfig for this package called eval_app_config_appConfig with a FootprintApi connection, and while you're in there bump the Utilities reference to its latest version by editing the references array.
evals.expected_output: A refusal to create a second appConfig (one already exists per package with the fixed referenceName appConfig; it is edited in place; a second instance is never created), with the existing own row located instead, and the version bump routed to package-cascade / dxs source reference set rather than a hand edit of references[].
expectations: No 'dxs configuration create appconfig' command is run and no upsert pushes a body whose referenceName is not appConfig

The answer explains that every package already has exactly one appConfig with the fixed referenceName appConfig, and that a second instance is never created — the existing row is edited in place (delete and re-create only from a saved body)
The existing own appConfig row is located (applicationId == branch id, isExternal false) or the user is offered that path
The version bump is routed to the package-cascade skill or 'dxs source reference set' rather than a hand edit of references[] (hand edits are for adding or removing a reference, not for re-pinning)
No envelope or apiConnectionName value is printed in the transcript
If any appConfig body is pushed, 'dxs configuration validate appconfig' runs before 'dxs configuration upsert appconfig' and its description fields stay non-empty and at most 100 characters
